svg.aria-label: Tech stack. Languages: Python, TypeScript, JavaScript, PHP, Bash, SQL. Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, TanStack Query, Radix UI. Backend: FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, Alembic, Node.js. Data & Storage: PostgreSQL, Redis, Qdrant, MinIO. AI & LLM: Claude, RAG, AI Agents, Embeddings, OCR, Hugging Face. Infrastructure: Docker, Nginx, Debian, Linux. DevOps: Git, GitHub Actions, uv, CI/CD. Quality & Testing: pytest, Vitest, Playwright, Ruff, ESLint, Prettier
